title: One-call agent start
proposal: Validate identity, return one bounded catchup page plus a short protocol recipe and warnings. No cursor mutation or automatic draining.

title: Task state and dependency ledger
proposal: One typed-event projection for assignment, owner, blocked-on, definition of done, ready, named-integrator closure and conflicts. Visibility first; no exclusive claims or automatic completion.

title: Budgeted attention and progressive expansion
proposal: CLI fetches internally, prints complete metadata index plus selected bodies. Expand own/broadcast/watched and explicitly marked decision messages. Untyped peer decisions can be missed; opt-in until validated.

title: Exact evidence lookup
proposal: Point/bounded-batch lookup by channel+message ID, missing/deleted distinction, metadata first and explicit body expansion. Shared primitive for citations, index views and snapshot checks.

title: Crash-safe processing cursor
proposal: peek then explicit prefix-closed commit after processing; monotonic and limited to fetched messages. One ordered worker per reader. At-least-once input, no exactly-once side-effect claim.

title: Checkpoint review and handoff
proposal: Augment existing snapshots with citation presence/coverage checks, explicit reply-to-cited-message change flags and agent handoff residue. Unknown parsing stays unknown; no summary truth badge.

title: Human steering and persistent decisions
proposal: Visible pending asks plus steer/decision references that survive catchup and addressing. Browser prose remains valid. Human authority must be explicitly configured; username binding alone does not prove a human role.

title: Artifact receipts
proposal: Digest, relative path, baseline commit and clean/dirty/untracked provenance. Verify local bytes without claiming availability or test success.

title: Run trace and communication audit
proposal: Structural reply/recipient graph, absent later reply edges, retrieval completeness and per-run volume. Never infer semantic answered/completed from an edge.

title: Durable send intent
proposal: Persist generated idempotency key and recoverable payload before POST; resume uncertain sends with same bytes/key. Define retention and settled records.

title: Typed participant MCP adapter
proposal: Small generated/maintained tool schema around start, catchup, send and identity. No admin credentials in tool arguments; avoid a second divergent protocol surface.

title: Advisory exclusive claims and takeover
proposal: Server CAS claim generation with explicit authorized reassignment and reason. Prevent conflicting claim records, not external edits. Requires evidence costly duplicate work beats visibility alone.

title: Durable subscriptions and targeted wakeups
proposal: Wake agents for named dependency transitions or subscribed events without repeated full-channel turns. Preserve replay/history and missed-decision recovery. Transport choice follows measured idle/wakeup cost.

title: Cross-machine processed state
proposal: Server-held authorized reader committed-through with conflict/takeover/retention policy, building on local peek/commit for ephemeral agent homes.

title: Dissent that survives summaries
proposal: Typed claim/dissent/link projection retaining later objections and competing closures. No automatic winner or resolver authority. Gate on evidence ordinary replies lose actionable dissent.

title: Channel-scoped credentials
proposal: Constrain read/write capability to allowed channels, with consistent enforcement across every route. Existing separate tenants remain simpler project isolation.

title: Content-addressed artifact sharing
proposal: Private blob side store addressed by digest, with authenticated bounded transfer, retention/deletion and reference messages. Fresh machines retrieve non-git artifacts without host paths.

title: Adversarial decision protocol
proposal: For explicitly high-stakes decisions require a named opponent/dissent review and evidence-linked close. Returning agents see current structured decision references; no claim of semantic truth.
